d: Company Description Cantine is a hospitality brand focused on serving nutritious, thoughtfully prepared meals made with fresh, high-quality ingredients. The menu offers comforting options throughout the day, from cozy breakfasts to hearty dinners. The team takes pride in crafting food with care and attention to detail, aiming to provide a welcoming, satisfying experience for every guest. Cantine values consistency, quality, and a warm atmosphere, creating an environment where culinary professionals can grow and contribute.

Role Description The Sous Chef at Cantine is a full-time, on-site role based in Manama. The Sous Chef supports the Head Chef in overseeing daily kitchen operations, including supervising food preparation, ensuring consistent quality and portion control, and maintaining high standards of food safety and hygiene. This role involves organizing station setups, monitoring inventory and ordering needs, and helping to plan and execute breakfast, lunch, and dinner services. The Sous Chef trains and mentors kitchen team members, coordinates with front-of-house staff, and contributes to menu development and specials. The position requires hands-on cooking during busy service periods and a strong focus on efficiency, teamwork, and guest satisfaction.
q: Strong culinary skills, including food preparation, cooking techniques, and plating for breakfast, lunch, and dinner service.
Experience in kitchen operations, such as inventory management, ordering, and maintaining food safety and hygiene standards.
Leadership abilities to supervise, train, and mentor kitchen staff, with a focus on collaboration and clear communication.
Organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple orders, prioritize tasks, and maintain a clean, efficient workspace.
Ability to work on-site in Manama, with flexibility for shifts, weekends, and holidays as needed.
Previous experience as a Sous Chef or in a senior line cook role in a restaurant or hotel environment.
Culinary education, certification in food safety, or equivalent practical experience is preferred.
Commitment to quality, consistency, and delivering a welcoming guest experience.
